target_customer: Consumers who train with Apple Watch and other wearables and want adaptive coaching
problem: Generic workout plans do not adapt to a person's recovery, sleep and fitness data.
business_model: Consumer app, free download with premium subscription

founders.name: Aditya Ganapathi
founders.background_notes: Per YC page; the company site calls him CEO.

education: Cornell (met Josh there, per the launch post)

founders.background_notes: Per YC page; a search result says he coached high school basketball before fitness technology.

competitors.name: Whoop Coach
competitors.what: GPT-4 powered AI coach inside the Whoop app

technical_complexity.rationale: LLM coaching on HealthKit and wearable data is standard mobile and API work.

defensibility.rationale: Wearable makers and fitness apps could add the same AI coach, as Whoop did in 2023.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Whoop shipped an AI coach in September 2023 and Freeletics launched Coach+ in July 2024, so the wedge was contested.

market_need_then: Wearable owners had abundant data and generic plans; no dated demand figures were found.

branding.domain_note: Uses corahealth.app rather than cora.com; legal entity is PurplePill AI, Inc.

brand_strength.rationale: Press page offers only screenshots and no brand coverage was found; the name is common.

outcome_analysis: Cora is active with a three person team and a live App Store product, but no funding amounts, user numbers or press were found. Large wearable and fitness brands launched AI coaches in the same period, so the outcome is unproven.
notes: The App Store link redirected and its page was not opened. A directory lists last stage as seed with Y Combinator only, no amount, so no round is recorded. Freeletics Coach+ (July 2024) is after the batch and excluded from the dated list.
